s: Which of the following describes the karewas of the Kashmir Valley?
o: Lacustrine gravel-and-mud terraces belonging to the Tertiary system
Floodplain deposits renewed annually by the Ganga
Coral reefs formed along the western coast
Young volcanic cones of the Trans-Himalaya
x: Karewas, also called Vudr, are lacustrine gravel-and-mud terraces in the Kashmir Valley and form part of the Tertiary system. They are famous for saffron cultivation.

s: By which name of the region south of Beas in Punjab State is called?
x:
Official key: Malwa. Strictly: Malwa lies south of the Sutlej; Doaba lies just south/east of the Beas.
Malwa is the region of Punjab south of the Sutlej (beyond the Beas–Sutlej doab); Majha lies between the Ravi and Beas, Doaba between the Beas and Sutlej.

s: Sirasanambedu, Kovanur and Suramala are iron ore mines located in the ____ district of Andhra Pradesh.
x:
APPSC key: Chittoor. Strictly the IBM mining plan registers the Sirasanambedu iron-ore mine under Nellore district (not an option), so the location is uncertain (IBM mine code 30APR15003).
The APPSC key places the Sirasanambedu, Kovanur and Suramala iron-ore mines in Chittoor district (the old Chittoor–Nellore border belt of the south).

s:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are INCORRECT for the mineral Asbestos?

I. Asbestos is known for its heat resistance capacity

II. Andhra Pradesh is the leading producer of Asbestos in India
x:
Key: Only II. Strictly Andhra Pradesh (Kadapa chrysotile) was India's only asbestos-producing State until 2013-14, so II was true then; no production since 2014-15 (IMYB 2022 Asbestos; Lok Sabha reply cited in web search).
The key marks only II incorrect: asbestos resists heat (I true), but India now has no asbestos production and Rajasthan holds most resources.

src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer (Works), APRO, ASO, HO and
s: Andhra Pradesh is the sole producer of which of the following minerals in India?
x:
Key: apatite. Strictly IMYB reports India's apatite production as nil since 2016-17, and AP's true sole-producer mineral is barytes (IMYB Apatite & Rock Phosphate reviews, web search).
The key is apatite: AP (Kasipatnam, Visakhapatnam) ranks first in apatite and was its producer; calcite, bauxite and dolomite come from several States.
